    Evaluation at the projective labels: full faithfulness (Lemma 2.9) #

    Construction 2.8 (con:projective-algebra): A₀ = ⊕_{x,y} D(P_y, P_x), the category algebra of the projective labels, and evaluation sends X to the module with components C(P_x, X). Lemma 2.9 (first part, graded-category.tex): under the vanishings for modules killed by e, "P ↦ Pe is fully faithful on proj Λ". The manuscript proves this with the multiplication map (Me) ⊗_{Λ_e} eΛ → M, whose kernel and cokernel are killed by e, and the vanishings. We use the same two steps without the tensor product: a map g on the e-parts is defined on the submodule generated by the e-part by ∑ λ_i m_i ↦ ∑ λ_i g(m_i), well defined because the discrepancy generates a submodule killed by e (Hom-vanishing), and it extends to the whole module because the quotient is killed by e (Ext¹-vanishing).

    add C is represented by finite families of labels; maps between families are matrices of morphisms.
